name: Photo Vault & Locker - Cabinit
subtitle: Lock, hide, and secure your photos, files, and videos with PIN and emoji protection.
description:
Cabinit is the private vault that does it all — hide photos and videos, lock files and documents, and browse the web with a built-in private browser. What other apps split into three downloads, Cabinit seals behind one passcode.

■ HIDE PHOTOS & VIDEOS
Import from your photo library, then remove the originals in one step. Blurred previews keep thumbnails unreadable until you open them, and a screenshot-proof slideshow plays full screen on a canvas screen captures can't record.

■ LOCK ANY FILE
Photos, videos, audio, PDFs, documents, ZIP archives — all stored, organized, and viewable in-app. Folders with grid or list views, search, favorites, storage insights, and a built-in reader for PDFs and comics.

■ BROWSE PRIVATELY
A full multi-tab private browser with an ad blocker lives inside your vault. Download images and files straight into Cabinit — no history, no traces in Safari, nothing left behind.

■ CATCH INTRUDERS
Every failed unlock attempt is logged with the date, time, and exactly what they typed. Intruder Photo silently snaps whoever enters the wrong passcode. Screenshot alerts and a recording shield protect the vault even while it's open.

■ A VAULT THEY'LL NEVER FIND
A decoy vault opens with its own passcode and shows harmless files, keeping your real vault invisible under pressure. Add a fake crash-screen cover, a shuffled keypad that defeats shoulder-surfers, and disguised app icons.

■ CAPTURE PRIVATELY
Shoot photos and video with the secure camera — they never touch your camera roll. Scan paperwork into PDFs, record voice memos, and write rich-text notes with drawings, all saved only inside the vault.

■ STAY IN CONTROL
• Face ID / Touch ID + PIN with a secret emoji key
• Multiple vaults, each with its own passcode
• Folder Lock: an extra Face ID gate on sensitive folders
• Self-destructing files on a timer, and optional self-destruct after failed logins
• Panic gestures: flip your phone face-down and it locks instantly
• Metadata scrubber strips GPS from photos before sharing
• Duplicate cleaner, 30-day trash recovery, auto-lock timer
• Encrypted, password-protected backup you can store anywhere

■ YOUR FILES STAY YOURS
Everything lives on your device. No cloud upload, no account to create, no tracking. The only copy of your vault is the one in your hand.

■ CABINIT PLUS
Unlock the decoy vault, intruder photo, folder lock, fake cover, panic gestures, encrypted backup, and unlimited storage with a Cabinit Plus subscription. Payment is charged to your Apple Account; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the period ends. Manage or cancel anytime in Settings.

features.title: PIN + Emoji Protection
features.description: Each folder is safeguarded by a 6-digit PIN code and an emoji of your choice, adding an extra layer of security.

features.title: Direct Sharing
features.description: Share photos, files, and videos to your private folders as easily as sending them to a friend — directly from any app.

features.title: Private Browser
features.description: Browse the web privately within your secure folder. History, bookmarks, and more — all behind your password.

features.title: Customizable Themes
features.description: Personalize your folders with themes, home screen pictures, and more. Make your private world reflect your style.

features.title: Ad-Free & Cloudless
features.description: No invasive ads, no external cloud services. Your content never leaves your device. Privacy comes first.
